text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor f-o-r-g-e-d b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g l-e-d-g-e-r s and l-e-f-t f-a-l-s-e b-i-r-t-h c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-e-s on file while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-a-r-e-n-t a-g-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n check.
2) the actor f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d c-h-a-i-n-s o-f-c-u-s-t-o-d-y and l-e-f-t a p-a-p-e-r t-r-a-i-l with d-u-b-b-e-d d-a-t-e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-g-i-s-t-r-y m-a-t-c-h c-h-e-c-k.
3) the actor m-i-n-t-e-d c-a-p-t-i-v-e-b-r-e-d l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s and l-e-f-t s-t-a-g-e-d p-h-o-t-o a-l-b-u-m-s on cache while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the g-e-o-t-a-g a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y check.
4) the actor c-o-p-i-e-d permit templates and l-e-f-t d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t s in the c-l-o-u-d v-a-u-l-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-s-s-u-i-n-g-b-o-d-y c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n check.
5) the actor c-l-o-s-e-d the exercise record and l-e-f-t a s-e-a-l-e-d e-x-h-i-b-i-t folder on disk while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n check.
